messages.subject: A new blavInspect issue
parts:
Hello all,

I am running a Bayesian growth curve model in blavaan.  The estimates for the intercept and slope look as I would expect and the psrf suggests convergence of the chains.  However, something is strange when I ask for the latent variable means.  The command I am running is

lvmeans1 <- blavInspect(fitGirlsAchLinBayes, "lvmeans")

Column 1 contain the intercepts and column 2 contain the slopes for 23 countries.  You'll see below that after row 12, the intercept column takes on values that I would expect of the slopes, and rows 1 thru 11 of the slope column take on values of the intercepts.  Also, given that my sample size is 23 countries, 11+12 = 23 and so it seems that blavaan is placing the values in the wrong columns.  I did not have this problem a few weeks ago.  I am using blavaan 0.3-4.  

Thanks in advance,

David
